crosswalks.label: Data Warehousing Specialists
crosswalks.rationale: Data warehousing work includes data validation, ETL mapping and data-quality responsibilities but also broader warehouse architecture.

crosswalks.label: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
crosswalks.rationale: QA contributes validation/failure discipline while data semantics and lineage are distinct.

findings.summary: Data-quality engineering combines warehouse/data validation work with QA-style evidence discipline; structural, semantic and repair authority must remain separate.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the specialization boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make structural checks, semantic validity and data-repair authority separate evidence surfaces.

nonclaims: No complete Data Quality Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
Occupational mappings are evidence, not profession identity.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No adjacent professional, platform, security, product or institutional authority is created.
